limitations: Eight synthetic spoken turns in a single ordered dialogue are not a general accuracy or latency guarantee.
Baseline incorrect answers are included in the all-response latency metric, but excluded from the separately labelled correct-answer latency.
No evidence of reduced median latency versus baseline: final prioritizes correct conversational context.
The fixed final 350 ms hedge launches a second model request before the first text in all eight final turns; extra quota/cost is expected.
Native check uses afplay of synthetic Russian speech through the real CoreAudio system-audio capture path; it does not establish live Discord-call performance.

Overlap check feeds synthetic PCM into the real STT/LLM path. The next question starts 50 ms after the first request, during STT finalization, then continues through answer generation; this is not a native-call overlap test.
Native and overlap samples use only 3 and 2 observations respectively. Failed pilot benchmark-harness runs are excluded from these authoritative output files.
